scripts.allure:open: powershell -Command "$port = 8000 + (Get-Random -Minimum 1 -Maximum 100); while (Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort $port -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $port = 8000 + (Get-Random -Minimum 1 -Maximum 100) }; if (-not (Test-Path '.\allure-report\index.html')) { Write-Host 'Allure report not found. Run npm run allure:generate first.'; exit 1 }; Start-Process python -ArgumentList '-m','http.server',$port,'-d','.\allure-report'; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 1500; Write-Host "Opening Allure report on http://127.0.0.1:$port"; Start-Process "http://127.0.0.1:$port""
scripts.allure:report: npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.allure:run: npm run test && npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
